review:
Undead circus performers on a 4x6 grid. Pragmatic keeps the description short: the brain symbol is the scatter that opens free spins, and wins can reach 5,000x.

With little published about the features, the demo is the best way to see how the bonus plays out. 96.5% RTP. A quirky horror theme for players who like discovering a game as they go.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
